scripts.check-types: test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" || { gofmt -l .; echo "^ run gofmt -w ."; exit 1; }; go vet ./...
scripts.install-local: go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=$(git describe --tags --match 'doti/v*' --abbrev=0 | sed 's|^doti/||')+dev.$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" -o "${DOTI_BIN_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}/doti" ./cmd/doti && "${DOTI_BIN_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}/doti" version
